say:0:1421341001:1.text: After the battle, we restrain Shirin and Bucho and turne our attention to studying the mechanical objects they had "summoned".
say:0:1421341001:1.source_cn: 战斗后，我们将芝琳与布乔制服，把他们捆到了一边，开始研...

say:2:1421341002:1.text: Oh, this is the same one as before. It's actually been repaired...
say:2:1421341002:1.source_cn: 唔，果然，这还是之前的那个，居然被修好了……

say:3:1421341003:1.text: As for this smaller one, it's a replica. Although only the rough outline is copied, the idea is very interesting.
say:3:1421341003:1.source_cn: 至于这个小点的，是复制品，虽然只复制出了个大概的轮廓，...

choice_prompt:4:1421341003.text: As for this smaller one, it's a replica. Although only the rough outline is copied, the idea is very interesting.
choice_prompt:4:1421341003.source_cn: 至于这个小点的，是复制品，虽然只复制出了个大概的轮廓，但思路——非常有趣！

say:5:1421341004:1.text: If one wanted to replicate this big one, you'd have to completely dismantle it first, but the was core destroyed during one of its previous battles.
say:5:1421341004:1.source_cn: 如果要复制这个大的，必须要完全拆解才行，但之前你们进来...

say:6:1421341005:1.text: If it's disassembled again, the big one will have to be completely scrapped. Also, there's no guarantee that its useful for research anymore.
say:6:1421341005:1.source_cn: 如果再拆解，只会让大的这个彻底报废，还不一定能研究出东西。

say:7:1421341006:1.text: But the person who replicated this was aware of this, so they didn't try.
say:7:1421341006:1.source_cn: 但是复制这个东西的人，非常敏锐地注意到了这一点，所以没...

say:8:1421341007:1.text: It was just repaired and during the repair phase, some knowledge was acquired. And with that knowledge and a little imagination, the small one was created.
say:8:1421341007:1.source_cn: 只是把它维修好，并且利用维修阶段获得的知识与一些想象力...

say:9:1421341008:1.text: Good observation skills with expert technical analysis add to that a desire for production and development and sprinkle in some innovative thinking... Now, that's what I call special.
say:9:1421341008:1.source_cn: 判断力、观察力、对技术的复现与创新……确实非常了不起！

say:10:1421341009:1.text: If it were me, I wouldn't be able to tell if there was something wrong with the big one...
say:10:1421341009:1.source_cn: ……如果是我，根本看不出这个大的到底哪里坏掉……

say:11:1421341010:1.text: Not to mention the possibility that disassembling it would render it useless. I can't tell just by looking at it.
say:11:1421341010:1.source_cn: 更别说拆解会导致它报废这个可能性，我连看都不一定看得出来。

say:12:1421341011:1.text: While everyone praises Inna as a prodigy, you must be a genius as well. Despite your youth, you understand these intricate machines so well, and you see her skills with remarkable insight... and this lab...
say:12:1421341011:1.source_cn: 伊娜虽然很厉害，但，你年纪轻轻，对这些复杂的机械却这么...

say:14:1421341013:1.text: Who am I? The person who made this lab!
say:14:1421341013:1.source_cn: 哼哼，你们所在的这个实验室就是我的！你问我是谁！

say:15:1421341014:1.text: What...? No, really, who are you?

say:17:1421341016:1.text: ... Apologies if I'm being too direct. I assume you must have some connection with the Ironheart Dominion. A descendent? A dwarven noble from the Empire, perhaps...?
say:17:1421341016:1.source_cn: …………呃，抱歉，我猜，你可能和钢心帝国有什么关系，是...

say:18:1421341017:1.text: Look at this lab! Look at this mechanical guard! Now, look at my face! You should know about Eldric's conspiracy and what he did, right?
say:18:1421341017:1.source_cn: ……你、你看这实验室！你看这机械守卫！！你再看看我！你...

say:19:1421341018:1.text: Yes, however, I studied mechanics, engineering, and smithing, but I never really learned much about history.
say:19:1421341018:1.source_cn: 呃，确实，但我是学机械和工程学的，兼修材料和锻冶，真的...

say:20:1421341019:1.text: Actually, if I can be honest with you, Eldric is the only dwarf among us who actually studied the liberal arts...
say:20:1421341019:1.source_cn: 说实在的，我们矮人里也就弗林一个喜欢研究文科那些东西……

say:21:1421341020:1.text: Let's take a step back. Here, you will see my design documents and my signature. You've, at least, seen the designer's seal, right?
say:21:1421341020:1.source_cn: 退一万步说，这里有我的设计图和签名！至少我设计师的名章...

say:22:1421341021:1.text: I oversee production and design implementation. To avoid getting too worked up over ridiculous designs, I've made it a habit not to check the designer's seal...
say:22:1421341021:1.source_cn: 我是主持生产和负责落实设计的，一般来说，为了避免看到离...

say:23:1421341022:1.text: Ah, now I get it! No wonder I couldn't stand those folks who only knew production, engineering, and implementation all those centuries ago.
say:23:1421341022:1.source_cn: ……啊啊啊！果然，几百年前我就讨厌这些只会搞工程和实践...

choice_prompt:24:1421341022.text: Ah, now I get it! No wonder I couldn't stand those folks who only knew production, engineering, and implementation all those centuries ago.
choice_prompt:24:1421341022.source_cn: ……啊啊啊！果然，几百年前我就讨厌这些只会搞工程和实践的家伙是有道理的！

say:25:1421341023:1.text: Did you just make a joke at my expense?! Helthor's beard! I-I don't know if I should laugh, cry, or tear my hair out!
say:25:1421341023:1.source_cn: 你果然在嘲笑我！赫托在下！我居然！我居然——啊！气死我了！
say:25:1421341023:1.male: Did you just make a joke at my expense?! Helthor's beard! I-I don't know if I should laugh, cry, or tear my hair out!
say:25:1421341023:1.female: Did you just make a joke at my expense?! Helthor's beard! I-I don't know if I should laugh, cry, or tear my hair out!

say:26:1421341025:1.text: Whatever! Let's skip this topic! Who am I doesn't matter! We need to focus on where we go from here.
say:26:1421341025:1.source_cn: 随、随便吧！跳过这个我身份的话题！我们接下来进去要小心了！

say:27:1421341026:1.text: My labor isn't that simple. There are a lot of materials, tools, and mechanisms left inside.
say:27:1421341026:1.source_cn: 我的实验室可没那么简单，里面留下了不少材料和机关！

say:28:1421341027:1.text: If Inna's skills are as good as she's shown us, there will be traps inside.
say:28:1421341027:1.source_cn: 如果伊娜的技术真的像她展示出来的那样出色的话，里面肯定...

say:29:1421341028:1.text: That I understand. Although I'm just a regular engineer, my own lab is also full of traps and explosives...
say:29:1421341028:1.source_cn: 我懂我懂，虽然我是工程师，但我自己的实验室也布了不少机...

choice_prompt:30:1421341028.text: That I understand. Although I'm just a regular engineer, my own lab is also full of traps and explosives...
choice_prompt:30:1421341028.source_cn: 我懂我懂，虽然我是工程师，但我自己的实验室也布了不少机关和地雷……

say:31:1421341029:1.text: In short, we have to be alert and careful! Alright, let's go!
say:31:1421341029:1.source_cn: 总之，提高警惕，我们出发！

say:33:1421341024:1.text: If I said the same thing to a mage, they'd immediately show respect and interest! Idiot dwarves don't know a thing!
say:33:1421341024:1.source_cn: 明明同样的话跟魔法师说他们立刻就会露出敬仰和感兴趣的表...
say:33:1421341024:1.male: If I said the same thing to a mage, they'd immediately show respect and interest! Idiot dwarves don't know a thing!
say:33:1421341024:1.female: If I said the same thing to a mage, they'd immediately show respect and interest! Idiot dwarves don't know a thing!

choice:24:1:2.text: Seems you have a blind spot.
choice:24:1:2.male: Seems you have a blind spot.
choice:24:1:2.female: Seems you have a blind spot.
